name: data/csv-report
title: CSV report script
summary: Python script that reads a CSV, checks its columns, groups and totals a column and writes a Markdown report.
when: Use when the user has a CSV file and wants totals grouped by a column written as a Markdown report.

name.about: Script name: file stem, prog name in the help text and the logger name.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, then run python3 {{name}}.py sample.csv --group <column> --sum <numeric column> --out report.md and python3 -m pytest -q.
